info.title: Trelis Studio
info.description: Trelis Studio API for ASR/TTS training, evaluation, and data prep. **For LLM agents:** fetch the machine-readable spec at `/openapi.json`.

get.description: API root — start here. Fetch the docs URL for full reference.

Get current user info.

Returns account details including HF org, whether an HF token is stored,
and credit balance. Useful for verifying integration setup.

List available models.

Returns base models supported by Trelis Studio. Fine-tuned models derived
from these families are also supported — use the base model's family to
understand compatibility.

No authentication required.

List API keys for the current user.

Accepts session cookie or `tsk_` API key. When called with a `tsk_`
key, results are scoped to that key's project (a query `project_id`
outside that scope returns an empty list).

Full keys are never returned — only the prefix for identification.

Get credit pool balance for the API key's project.

The key is always project-scoped (falls back to the personal project
for legacy keys), so the returned balance is the pool that jobs run
under this key will debit.

post.description:
Estimate cost for a job.

Returns the estimated cost based on duration and job type.
GPU training uses H100 pricing. Data-service jobs (transcription,
synthesis, mos, data_prep) use the data-service rate.

get.description:
Get transaction history.

Returns recent credit transactions (purchases, usage, bonuses).

Get current tier info including job usage.

Returns the user's tier, limits, current usage, and upgrade info.

post.summary: Submit a v2 data prep job
post.description:
Submit a v2 data prep job (§6.2).

Input is either a FileStore (`file_store_id`) or an HF dataset (`dataset_id`).
Both are validated against the data_prep service contract (§3.2.3):
must carry `audio` + `text` columns. Output is a `chunked_dataset`.

Submit a v2 synthesis job (§5.4).

Input is one of: inline text, HF dataset, or FileStore. Batch inputs are
streamed in chunks (§5.8) — see PR #696 for the orchestrator-side pipeline.
The result carries `content_type="generated_audio"` with a §3.2 column
manifest; when ``filter_threshold`` is set, kept/dropped/unscored sibling
FileStores are linked via `extra_metadata.sibling_file_store_id` (each
non-primary sibling points at the primary, per the kept > dropped >
unscored priority).

Submit a v2 Transcription job (§4.6).

Stage 1: authentication (``require_api_key``) + credits + concurrency
         + credential resolution + S3 config.
Stage 2: input validation via ``resolve_input_source`` (§3.2 contract
         check + FileStore ownership scoping + HF dataset features
         probe).
Stage 3: pre-mint ``job_id`` + commit ``Job`` row (credentials
         EXCLUDED) + ``background_tasks.add_task`` with the
         ephemeral credentials dict.

DELETE is not the right verb for job cancellation here; the
project uses POST /jobs/{job_id}/cancel instead (credits charged
up to cancellation). ``require_api_key`` is enforced so
unauthenticated probes get a 401 rather than learning the job-id
namespace exists from a 405.

Get a presigned PUT URL to upload a single file into a FileStore.

If `file_store_id` is omitted, a new FileStore is created. Pass the
returned `file_store_id` in subsequent calls to add more files to the
same store.

The `content_type` in the response **must** be sent as the `Content-Type`
header on the PUT request — S3 signs the URL with this value and will
return 403 if it doesn't match.

Get presigned PUT URLs for multiple files in one call (up to 5000).

Returns the same `file_store_id` for all files — they all land in the
same FileStore. Pass `file_store_id` to append to an existing store.

The `content_type` in each response entry **must** be sent as the
`Content-Type` header on the corresponding PUT request.

Auth: API-key (``Authorization: Bearer tsk_…``) OR session cookie.
The UI calls this from ``data_prep.html``; API consumers use Bearer.

Returns a job_id to poll and a file_store_id that will be populated
once the download completes.

Supported formats: ZIP, TAR/TAR.GZ/TAR.BZ2/TAR.XZ, single audio file.

Use `url` for a single URL or `urls` for multiple. Set `file_store_id`
to append to an existing FileStore instead of creating a new one.

Run data prep on a FileStore and push the result to HuggingFace.

Equivalent to POST /data-prep/sessions/{id}/process with file_store_ids,
but without needing a session. The FileStore must have source 'upload'
or 'draft_transcribe'.

Returns a job_id. Poll GET /data-prep/jobs/{job_id} for status.
Result will contain hf_dataset_id when complete.

`dataset_info.json` sidecar is generated with column schema and row count.

The resulting FileStore is reusable as input to any pipeline
(evaluation, training, filtering, data prep) — same as an HF-imported
FileStore.

post.summary: Submit a v2 training job (ASR or TTS)
post.description:
Submit a v2 training job (§11 + #685 Phase 5).

Unified endpoint for ASR + TTS. ``job_type`` discriminates; ASR
dispatches to ``start_training`` (5 backends: whisper / moonshine /
voxtral / qwen / parakeet). TTS dispatches to ``start_tts_training``
for single-GPU runs and ``start_tts_training_ddp`` when
``num_gpus > 1`` (absorption decision A on #685 — formerly the
DDP variants required posting to ``/api/v1/tts-training-ddp/jobs``
directly). The DDP route is kept live for API back-compat but
the v2 endpoint is now the canonical way to submit DDP jobs.

v2 delta over the legacy ``/api/v1/training/jobs`` +
``/api/v1/tts-training/jobs`` routes:

- FileStore inputs are contract-validated (§3.2) against the
  training service contract BEFORE the Job row is minted.
  Bad ``content_type`` or missing required columns (``audio``,
  ``text``) return 400 here — no wasted Modal spin-up.
- Consistent response envelope: whatever the legacy handler
  returned (``{job_id, status, message, ...}``) plus ``v2: True``.
  The ``balance`` key is included when the legacy handler returns
  it (i.e. when credits are decremented on job creation); callers
  should treat it as optional.

Start an evaluation job.

Evaluates an ASR model on a dataset and returns WER (Word Error Rate) and CER (Character Error Rate).
Returns immediately with job_id — poll GET /jobs/{job_id} for status.

**Limits:** Requires minimum $1.00 credit balance.
Job timeout and concurrent job slots depend on your tier — call GET /billing/tier to check.

DataPrepRequest.description: v2 data prep request — one input source, params grouped per §6.2.

dataset_id.title: Dataset Id
dataset_id.description: HuggingFace dataset ID, e.g. 'my-org/my-dataset'. Mutually exclusive with file_store_id.

file_store_id.title: File Store Id
file_store_id.description: FileStore UUID for S3-backed dataset. Mutually exclusive with dataset_id.

config.title: Config
config.description: Dataset config name, for datasets with multiple subsets (e.g. 'en_us' in google/fleurs).

samples_per_epoch.title: Samples Per Epoch
samples_per_epoch.description: Number of samples to draw from this dataset per epoch (cap / sub-sample). If unset, the full dataset is used once per epoch. Must be ≤ the dataset's row count — oversampling is not supported. Requests exceeding the dataset size are rejected at the API layer (or clamped at train time for FileStore/parquet inputs whose size is unknown upfront).

DatasetSpec.title: DatasetSpec
DatasetSpec.description: Specification for a single training dataset.

model_id.title: Model Id
model_id.description: HuggingFace model ID to evaluate. Supported model families: Whisper (openai/whisper-tiny, openai/whisper-base, openai/whisper-small, openai/whisper-medium, openai/whisper-large-v3-turbo, openai/whisper-large-v3, leduckhai/MultiMed-ST/asr/whisper-small-english), Moonshine (UsefulSensors/moonshine-tiny, UsefulSensors/moonshine-base, plus language-specific variants), Voxtral (mistralai/Voxtral-Mini-3B-2507), Qwen ASR (Qwen/Qwen3-ASR-0.6B, Qwen/Qwen3-ASR-1.7B), Parakeet (nvidia/parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v3), Canary (nvidia/canary-1b-v2), OmniASR (facebook/omniASR-LLM-7B, inference only), VibeVoice (microsoft/VibeVoice-ASR-HF, inference only), Cohere Transcribe (CohereLabs/cohere-transcribe-03-2026, inference only), MedASR (google/medasr, English medical domain, inference only), as well as fine-tuned models from any of the trainable families. Router models (e.g. fireworks/whisper-v3, deepgram/nova-3, google/gemini-2.5-pro) are also supported — see GET /api/v1/models?family=router for the full list.

model_file_store_id.title: Model File Store Id
model_file_store_id.description: FileStore UUID containing model weights (S3). When provided, model is loaded from S3 instead of HuggingFace.

dataset_id.title: Dataset Id
dataset_id.description: HuggingFace dataset ID (e.g. 'Trelis/llm-lingo'). Mutually exclusive with parquet_url and file_store_id.

parquet_url.title: Parquet Url
parquet_url.description: Presigned or public URL to a .parquet file containing evaluation data. Must have columns: 'audio' (bytes or path) and 'text' (reference transcript). Mutually exclusive with dataset_id and file_store_id. Also accepts a list of URLs for multi-shard parquet datasets.

file_store_id.title: File Store Id
file_store_id.description: FileStore UUID for S3-backed evaluation dataset. Mutually exclusive with dataset_id and parquet_url.

language.title: Language
language.description: Language for ASR evaluation. Default 'auto' auto-detects for Whisper, Qwen, VibeVoice, Voxtral, and Router models. OmniASR and Cohere Transcribe require an explicit language (returns error if set to 'auto'). Use a full language name (e.g., 'english', 'greek', 'french') to force a specific language. Use 'multilingual' to read per-sample language from dataset 'language' column. Also controls WER/CER text normalization: Greek ('greek'/'el'/'ell') uses a Greek-specific normalizer (strips diacriticals, normalizes sigma variants). All other languages, including 'auto', use a generic Unicode-aware normalizer (lowercase, strip punctuation, preserve all scripts).

enable_timestamps.title: Enable Timestamps
enable_timestamps.description: Enable timestamp evaluation. Only applies to Whisper models with datasets containing a 'text_ts' column. Defaults to False.

normalizer.title: Normalizer
normalizer.description: Text normalizer for WER/CER computation. Options: 'auto' (select based on language — e.g., Greek normalizer for Greek), 'generic' (Unicode-aware: lowercase, strip punctuation, preserve all scripts), 'whisper-english' (aggressive English normalizer — numbers, contractions, fillers, British spelling), 'none' (no normalization — compare raw text), or a language name (e.g., 'greek').

max_duration.title: Max Duration
max_duration.description: Maximum audio duration in seconds. Samples longer than this are skipped during evaluation. Default 30s (Whisper/Moonshine architecture limit). Increase for models that support longer audio.

router_max_concurrency.title: Router Max Concurrency
router_max_concurrency.description: Max parallel requests to Trelis Router for proprietary ASR models. Lower this if your Router API key has a low requests-per-minute limit.

``transcript_type`` is the canonical wire-format tag; the UI uses it to
label the editor and the download button. Values correspond 1:1 to the
file extensions ``.vtt``/``.srt``/``.txt`` — ``vtt_content`` is named
historically; for SRT/TXT it carries the raw body of the respective
format (no on-the-fly conversion).

``transcript_type`` selects the target file extension + Content-Type:
``vtt`` → ``{stem}.vtt`` (text/vtt), ``srt`` → ``{stem}.srt`` (text/plain),
``txt`` → ``{stem}.txt`` (text/plain). Sibling extensions for the same
stem are cleaned up on successful PUT so exactly one transcript per stem
remains on disk.

num_samples.description: Maximum number of samples to score.

push_results.title: Push Results
push_results.description: Push scored dataset to HuggingFace. Defaults to True if HF token is available.

output_org.title: Output Org
output_org.description: HuggingFace organization for the output dataset.

output_name.title: Output Name
output_name.description: Custom name for the output dataset. Defaults to '{dataset}-mos-eval'.

MOSEvaluationRequest.title: MOSEvaluationRequest
MOSEvaluationRequest.description: Request to start a MOS evaluation job.

ParquetUploadResponse.title: ParquetUploadResponse
ParquetUploadResponse.description: Response from uploading a parquet file to a new FileStore.

output_target.title: Output Target
output_target.description: Override output target. If omitted, resolved from project settings (S3 if configured, HF if enabled, both if both).

output_org.title: Output Org
output_org.description: Deprecated — ignored. The HF org from project settings is used automatically.

hf_token.title: Hf Token
hf_token.description: Deprecated — ignored. The HF token from project settings is used automatically.

private.title: Private
private.description: Deprecated — always True. Repos are always created as private.

split_option.title: Split Option
split_option.description: 'create_validation' creates 80/15/5 train/validation/test splits; 'train_only' puts all data in train; 'validation_only' pushes all data as a validation split; 'test_only' pushes all data as a test split.

min_char_density.title: Min Char Density
min_char_density.description: Minimum chars/sec — chunks below this are dropped as misaligned. None = no lower bound. Typical speech is ~20-25 chars/sec; 6 is a reasonable floor.

max_char_density.title: Max Char Density
max_char_density.description: Maximum chars/sec — chunks above this are dropped as clipped/sped-up. None = no upper bound. 32 is a reasonable ceiling.

dedup_text.title: Dedup Text
dedup_text.description: Drop rows with identical transcript text (case-insensitive). Logs dropped count.

dedup_audio.title: Dedup Audio
dedup_audio.description: Drop rows with identical audio key (source_file + start_time + end_time). Catches duplicate segments from the same source file.

detect_repetitions.title: Detect Repetitions
detect_repetitions.description: Drop rows where the transcript contains repeated phrases. Uses two checks: contiguous exact repeat of ≥3 words, and trigram ratio above threshold.

repetition_threshold.title: Repetition Threshold
repetition_threshold.description: Max fraction of trigrams that may be the same trigram. Only used when detect_repetitions=True. Default 0.3 (30%).

repetition_min_words.title: Repetition Min Words
repetition_min_words.description: Minimum word count before repetition check runs. Samples shorter than this skip the check. Default 8.

strip_annotations.title: Strip Annotations
strip_annotations.description: Strip bracketed annotations (e.g. [music], [laughter], [unintelligible]) from transcripts. Rows that become empty after stripping are dropped.

annotation_regex.title: Annotation Regex
annotation_regex.description: Custom regex for annotation stripping. Defaults to r'\[\w[^\]]*\]' when strip_annotations=True and this is None. Max 200 chars.

language.title: Language
language.description: Language of the audio. Accepted formats: full name ('english', 'irish'), ISO 639-1 ('en', 'ga'), or ISO 639-3 ('eng', 'gle'). Used for text romanization during forced alignment (uroman) and injected as an ISO 639-1 code into the dataset 'language' column. Setting the correct language improves alignment accuracy for non-Latin scripts.

segment_padding_ms.title: Segment Padding Ms
segment_padding_ms.description: Padding (ms) added around each SRT/VTT segment boundary when extracting audio for alignment. Default 150ms. Only used for .srt/.vtt transcripts; ignored for .txt.

silence_threshold_ms.title: Silence Threshold Ms
silence_threshold_ms.description: Silence gap (ms) between words that triggers a segment split. Default 2000ms. Only used for .txt transcripts; ignored for .srt/.vtt.

target_chunk_duration.title: Target Chunk Duration
target_chunk_duration.description: Soft target for chunk duration in seconds. For SRT/VTT with pack=False, each segment becomes its own sample.

max_chunk_duration.title: Max Chunk Duration
max_chunk_duration.description: Hard cap for chunk duration in seconds (max 30s for Whisper)

min_chunk_duration.title: Min Chunk Duration
min_chunk_duration.description: Filter out chunks shorter than this duration in seconds (always applied). Default 1s.

pack.title: Pack
pack.description: If True, concatenate speech segments (removes silence) — improves training efficiency for longer runs. If False (default), each segment becomes its own sample with realistic segment lengths representative of real-world inference — recommended for training where the model needs to handle natural audio boundaries. For .srt/.vtt, segments come from transcript timestamps. For .txt, segments come from word-gap clustering (silence_threshold_ms).

vad_threshold.title: Vad Threshold
vad_threshold.description: Silero VAD sensitivity for audio-only file transcription (lower = more sensitive). Only used when the file store contains audio-only files (no paired transcripts). Default 0.5 is Silero's calibrated general-purpose threshold. Use 0.25 for quiet/radio audio (e.g. ATC) to avoid missed speech.

audio_cleaning.title: Audio Cleaning
audio_cleaning.description: Audio cleaning applied before alignment and to extracted speech chunks. Default 'none' preserves the original audio — important for ASR training where cleaning can filter out the 'hard' examples the model needs to learn from. Users can opt in (e.g. for TTS data) when cleaning is desired. 'none': no processing. 'basic': highpass filter at 80Hz + LUFS normalization to -12dBFS. 'denoise': basic + spectral gating noise reduction (prop_decrease=0.6).

target_sr.title: Target Sr
target_sr.description: Output sample rate for audio chunks in the HuggingFace dataset. 16000 Hz for ASR models (Whisper, Moonshine, Voxtral, Parakeet). 22050 Hz for Piper TTS. 24000 Hz for Orpheus TTS.

save_cleaned_audio.title: Save Cleaned Audio
save_cleaned_audio.description: When True and audio_cleaning is not 'none', include a 'clean_audio' column in the HuggingFace dataset with the denoised version of each chunk. The 'audio' column remains the raw (silence-stripped) audio.

enable_confidence_filter.title: Enable Confidence Filter
enable_confidence_filter.description: Split files at runs of low-confidence alignment spans rather than rejecting whole files. Language-agnostic: uses per-file percentile of wav2vec2 log-prob scores.

confidence_percentile_threshold.title: Confidence Percentile Threshold
confidence_percentile_threshold.description: Words below this within-file percentile (of alignment confidence) are flagged as low-quality. Default 15 means bottom 15% of each file's score distribution.

bad_span_min_words.title: Bad Span Min Words
bad_span_min_words.description: Minimum consecutive low-confidence words to trigger a split. Higher values tolerate technical terms that score low in isolation.

confidence_absolute_floor.title: Confidence Absolute Floor
confidence_absolute_floor.description: Reject the entire file if its median word score is below this log-prob floor. Guards against completely wrong transcripts.

confidence_segment_threshold.title: Confidence Segment Threshold
confidence_segment_threshold.description: VTT/SRT only: drop segments whose median CTC word score falls below this absolute threshold. Only applies when enable_confidence_filter=True and input has SRT/VTT transcripts.

file_store_ids.title: File Store Ids
file_store_ids.description: IDs of previously saved file stores to use as input. When provided, files are loaded from the Modal volume — no upload needed. Multiple stores are merged into a single dataset. Obtain IDs from GET /api/v1/data-prep/file-stores.

file_store_name.title: File Store Name
file_store_name.description: Name for the file store that will be created after processing. Defaults to the output_dataset_name if not provided. Has no effect when file_store_ids is provided (re-run, not a new upload).

ProcessRequest.title: ProcessRequest
ProcessRequest.description:
Request to process and push to HuggingFace.

Used by both web routes and API v1 endpoints.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: Evaluation mode: 'paired' (ref + gen columns in same dataset) or 'single_ref' (separate ref dataset).

dataset_id.title: Dataset Id
dataset_id.description: HuggingFace dataset ID with generated audio (e.g. 'Trelis/my-tts-output').

ref_audio_column.title: Ref Audio Column
ref_audio_column.description: Column containing reference audio (paired mode only).

ref_dataset_id.title: Ref Dataset Id
ref_dataset_id.description: HuggingFace dataset ID with reference speaker audio (single_ref mode only).

ref_split.title: Ref Split
ref_split.description: Split of the reference dataset (single_ref mode only).

ref_column.title: Ref Column
ref_column.description: Audio column in the reference dataset (single_ref mode only).

num_ref_samples.title: Num Ref Samples
num_ref_samples.description: Number of reference samples to average for centroid (single_ref mode, default 1).

push_results.title: Push Results
push_results.description: Push scored dataset to HuggingFace. Defaults to True if HF token is available.

output_org.title: Output Org
output_org.description: HuggingFace organization for the output dataset.

output_name.title: Output Name
output_name.description: Custom name for the output dataset.

sv_model.title: Sv Model
sv_model.description: Speaker verification model. 'ecapa' (default): SpeechBrain ECAPA-TDNN, Apache 2.0, commercial-safe, compressed 0.9-1.0 scale on TTS audio. 'wavlm_large_sv': WavLM-Large + ECAPA-TDNN from seed-tts-eval (Chen et al. 2022b), paper-comparable 0.2-0.8 scale; checkpoint license unclear — check before commercial use.

SpeakerSimilarityRequest.title: SpeakerSimilarityRequest
SpeakerSimilarityRequest.description: Request to start a speaker similarity evaluation job.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: 'paired': dataset has both generated_audio and ref_audio columns (typical ZSVC eval output). 'single_ref': generated dataset + separate reference dataset.

dataset_id.title: Dataset Id
dataset_id.description: HuggingFace dataset id with generated audio.

ref_dataset_id.title: Ref Dataset Id
ref_dataset_id.description: Single-ref mode only: HF dataset with reference speaker audio.

push_results.title: Push Results
push_results.description: Push scored dataset to HF Hub. Defaults to True when HF token available.

output_target.title: Output Target
output_target.description: Where to write the scored dataset. Project permissions gate this.

output_name.title: Output Name
output_name.description: Custom name for the output HF dataset (if pushed).

sv_model.title: Sv Model
sv_model.description: 'wavlm_large_sv' (default): WavLM-Large + ECAPA-TDNN from seed-tts-eval. Paper-comparable 0.2–0.8 scale. 'ecapa': SpeechBrain ECAPA, Apache 2.0, commercial-safe, compressed 0.9–1.0 on TTS audio.

SpeakerSimilarityV2Request.title: SpeakerSimilarityV2Request
SpeakerSimilarityV2Request.description: v2 speaker-similarity request — FileStore or HF dataset, contract-validated.

model.title: Model
model.description: TTS model id. Engine is auto-resolved from this unless `engine` is set.

language.title: Language
language.description: ISO 639-1 code. Required by Chatterbox; Orpheus/Piper accept 'en'/'auto'.

file_store_id.title: File Store Id
file_store_id.description: FileStore containing raw_text / audio_text_pairs / chunked_dataset / transcribed_dataset.

dataset_id.title: Dataset Id
dataset_id.description: HuggingFace dataset id with a `text` column.

reference_column.title: Reference Column
reference_column.description: Reference column for CER scoring (defaults to prompt text).

asr_model_id.title: Asr Model Id
asr_model_id.description: Router ASR model for round-trip CER (e.g. fireworks/whisper-v3).

filter_threshold.title: Filter Threshold
filter_threshold.description: CER cutoff. Samples with CER > threshold go into the `dropped` sibling shard.

chunk_size.title: Chunk Size
chunk_size.description: Streaming chunk size — peak orchestrator memory is two chunks (§5.8).

output_name.title: Output Name
output_name.description: Output FileStore name; auto-generated if omitted.

SynthesisRequest.title: SynthesisRequest
SynthesisRequest.description: v2 synthesis request — one input source, params grouped per §5.4.

file_store_id.title: File Store Id
file_store_id.description: FileStore UUID to use as training dataset (must contain parquet files). Mutually exclusive with train_dataset.

max_train_samples.title: Max Train Samples
max_train_samples.description: Limit training to a random subset of N samples. Useful for quick smoke tests.

max_validation_rows.title: Max Validation Rows
max_validation_rows.description: Max validation samples evaluated during training (baseline, periodic, final).

TTSTrainingDDPRequest.title: TTSTrainingDDPRequest
TTSTrainingDDPRequest.description: Request to start a TTS DDP training job.

tts_type.title: Tts Type
tts_type.description: TTS model type: 'orpheus' (neural, expressive, LoRA on H100) or 'piper' (lightweight VITS, full fine-tune on A100).

training_variant.title: Training Variant
training_variant.description: Orpheus only: 'finetune' (default, single-voice LoRA) or 'zsvc' (zero-shot voice cloning — trains with ref+target turn structure so the model clones from a reference clip at inference). 'zsvc' requires a dataset with a 'speaker_id' column.

zsvc_min_ref_seconds.title: Zsvc Min Ref Seconds
zsvc_min_ref_seconds.description: ZSVC only: minimum per-speaker reference audio duration (clips are concatenated to reach this). Held out from the training target pool.

base_model.title: Base Model
base_model.description: Model to fine-tune. Orpheus: HuggingFace model ID (e.g. 'canopylabs/orpheus-3b-0.1-ft'). Piper: use '__default__' to auto-select a checkpoint matched to your language, or specify a checkpoint from the rhasspy/piper-checkpoints dataset repo using colon-separated format: 'rhasspy/piper-checkpoints:<lang_path>/<voice>/<quality>' (e.g. 'rhasspy/piper-checkpoints:en/en_GB/alan/medium'). Leave empty to train Piper from scratch (for unsupported languages).

base_model_file_store_id.title: Base Model File Store Id
base_model_file_store_id.description: FileStore UUID containing model weights (S3). Mutually exclusive with base_model as HF ID.

train_dataset.title: Train Dataset
train_dataset.description: HuggingFace dataset ID for training, e.g. 'my-org/my-tts-data'. Mutually exclusive with file_store_id.

file_store_id.title: File Store Id
file_store_id.description: FileStore UUID to use as training dataset (must contain parquet files). Mutually exclusive with train_dataset.

train_split.title: Train Split
train_split.description: Dataset split to use for training.

train_dataset_config.title: Train Dataset Config
train_dataset_config.description: Dataset config name, for datasets with multiple subsets.

validation_dataset.title: Validation Dataset
validation_dataset.description: Validation dataset ID. If omitted, validation_pct of training data is used.

validation_split.title: Validation Split
validation_split.description: Dataset split to use for validation.

validation_dataset_config.title: Validation Dataset Config
validation_dataset_config.description: Config name for the validation dataset.

output_org.title: Output Org
output_org.description: HuggingFace org/user to push the trained model to. Required if push_to_hub is true.

output_model_name.title: Output Model Name
output_model_name.description: Name for the output model repo. Auto-generated if omitted.

push_to_hub.title: Push To Hub
push_to_hub.description: Push the trained model to HuggingFace Hub when training completes.

private.title: Private
private.description: Deprecated — always True. Repos are always created as private.

lora_rank.title: Lora Rank
lora_rank.description: Orpheus only: LoRA rank. Higher values increase model capacity but use more memory.

lora_alpha.title: Lora Alpha
lora_alpha.description: Orpheus only: LoRA alpha scaling factor.

train_embeddings.title: Train Embeddings
train_embeddings.description: Orpheus only: whether to train input/output embedding layers.

batch_size.title: Batch Size
batch_size.description: Global batch size (total samples per optimizer step across all GPUs). Must be a power of 2. Leave blank to auto-recommend based on dataset size (recommended).

gradient_accumulation_steps.title: Gradient Accumulation Steps
gradient_accumulation_steps.description: Gradient accumulation steps. Auto-derived from global batch size and GPU count. Only provide to override.

learning_rate.title: Learning Rate
learning_rate.description: Learning rate. Leave blank to auto-recommend based on dataset size (recommended).

epochs.title: Epochs
epochs.description: Number of training epochs. Leave blank to auto-recommend based on dataset size (recommended).

max_seq_length.title: Max Seq Length
max_seq_length.description: Max sequence length (interleaved text+audio tokens). Orpheus uses ~82 audio tokens/sec, so 4096 ≈ ~49s of audio. Samples exceeding this are skipped.

warmup_steps.title: Warmup Steps
warmup_steps.description: Number of warmup steps for the learning rate scheduler.

speaker_name.title: Speaker Name
speaker_name.description: Speaker identifier in the generated model. Should match the speaker label in your dataset.

quality.title: Quality
quality.description: Piper only: voice quality — 'x-low' (~5M params, fastest), 'medium' (~16M params, balanced), or 'high' (~36M params, best quality). Must match the quality level of your base checkpoint.

language.title: Language
language.description: Piper only: espeak-ng language code (e.g. 'en-us', 'en-gb', 'de', 'fr', 'es', 'pt-br', 'ar', 'zh'). Used for phonemization and for resolving '__default__' checkpoints. 68 languages supported.

validation_pct.title: Validation Pct
validation_pct.description: Piper only: fraction of training data to hold out for validation (0.0–1.0).

push_preprocessed.title: Push Preprocessed
push_preprocessed.description: Piper only: push the preprocessed dataset (phonemized + mel spectrograms) to HuggingFace Hub for reuse.

preprocessed_dataset.title: Preprocessed Dataset
preprocessed_dataset.description: Piper only: HF dataset ID with pre-processed data. Skips preprocessing step if provided.

max_train_samples.title: Max Train Samples
max_train_samples.description: Limit training to a random subset of N samples. Useful for quick smoke tests.

max_validation_rows.title: Max Validation Rows
max_validation_rows.description: Max validation samples evaluated during training (baseline, periodic, final).

wandb_run_name.title: Wandb Run Name
wandb_run_name.description: W&B run name. Auto-generated if omitted.

TTSTrainingRequest.title: TTSTrainingRequest
TTSTrainingRequest.description: Request to start a TTS training job.

file_store_id.title: File Store Id
file_store_id.description: FileStore UUID holding a chunked / transcribed / generated-audio dataset. v2 contract validation (§3.2) runs before the Job is minted. Shortcut for single-dataset runs — callers who need per-row `samples_per_epoch` / `config` or multiple datasets must use `train_datasets`. Mutually exclusive with `train_datasets` and `train_dataset`.

TrainingASRV2Request.title: TrainingASRV2Request
TrainingASRV2Request.description:
v2 ASR training sub-model. All fields mirror the legacy
`TrainingRequest` one-for-one so the adapter is a ``.model_dump()``
round-trip — adding / renaming a field on either side requires the
matching change here.

Input source rule (enforced by model validator): exactly one of
``train_datasets`` / ``train_dataset`` / ``file_store_id`` at the
top level. The top-level ``file_store_id`` is a convenience
shortcut for single-FileStore runs — callers who need per-row
options (``config``, ``samples_per_epoch``, mixed HF+FileStore
sources) must use the ``train_datasets`` list. ``base_model_file_store_id``
is orthogonal — it's a model-weights FileStore, not a dataset
input, and is not subject to §3.2 dataset-contract validation.

base_model.title: Base Model
base_model.description: HuggingFace model ID for the base model to fine-tune. Supported model families: Whisper (openai/whisper-tiny, openai/whisper-base, openai/whisper-small, openai/whisper-medium, openai/whisper-large-v3-turbo, openai/whisper-large-v3), Moonshine (UsefulSensors/moonshine-tiny, UsefulSensors/moonshine-base, plus language-specific variants like moonshine-tiny-ar, moonshine-base-zh, etc.), Qwen ASR (Qwen/Qwen3-ASR-0.6B, Qwen/Qwen3-ASR-1.7B), Voxtral (mistralai/Voxtral-Mini-3B-2507), Parakeet (nvidia/parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v3). You can also pass a fine-tuned model ID from any of these families.

base_model_file_store_id.title: Base Model File Store Id
base_model_file_store_id.description: FileStore UUID containing model weights (S3). Mutually exclusive with base_model as HF ID.

train_datasets.title: Train Datasets
train_datasets.description: List of training datasets (recommended). Use this OR train_dataset, not both.

train_dataset.title: Train Dataset
train_dataset.description: Single training dataset ID (legacy). Prefer train_datasets for new integrations.

train_split.title: Train Split
train_split.description: Dataset split to use for training.

train_dataset_config.title: Train Dataset Config
train_dataset_config.description: Dataset config name, for datasets with multiple subsets (e.g. 'en_us' in google/fleurs).

validation_dataset.title: Validation Dataset
validation_dataset.description: Validation dataset ID. If omitted, a portion of the training data is used.

validation_split.title: Validation Split
validation_split.description: Dataset split to use for validation.

validation_dataset_config.title: Validation Dataset Config
validation_dataset_config.description: Config name for the validation dataset, if it has multiple subsets.

output_org.title: Output Org
output_org.description: HuggingFace org/user to push the trained model to, e.g. 'my-org'. Required if push_to_hub is true.

output_model_name.title: Output Model Name
output_model_name.description: Name for the output model repo, e.g. 'whisper-large-v3-turbo-my-data'. Auto-generated if omitted.

push_to_hub.title: Push To Hub
push_to_hub.description: Push the trained model to HuggingFace Hub when training completes.

batch_size.title: Batch Size
batch_size.description: Global batch size (total samples per optimizer step across all GPUs). Must be a power of 2. Leave blank to auto-recommend based on dataset size (recommended).

gradient_accumulation_steps.title: Gradient Accumulation Steps
gradient_accumulation_steps.description: Gradient accumulation steps. Auto-derived from global batch size and GPU count. Only provide to override.

learning_rate.title: Learning Rate
learning_rate.description: Learning rate. Leave blank to auto-recommend based on dataset size (recommended).

epochs.title: Epochs
epochs.description: Number of training epochs. Leave blank to auto-recommend based on dataset size (recommended).

lora_rank.title: Lora Rank
lora_rank.description: LoRA rank. Higher values increase model capacity but use more memory.

use_rslora.title: Use Rslora
use_rslora.description: Use Rank-Stabilized LoRA (RSLoRA) for more stable training.

lora_target.title: Lora Target
lora_target.description: Which modules to apply LoRA to: 'both' (encoder + decoder) or 'decoder_only'.

train_embeddings.title: Train Embeddings
train_embeddings.description: Whether to train input/output embedding layers (increases memory usage).

private.title: Private
private.description: Deprecated — always True. Repos are always created as private.

enable_timestamps.title: Enable Timestamps
enable_timestamps.description: Enable timestamp token training. When enabled, 50% of training data uses timestamp tokens.

wandb_entity.title: Wandb Entity
wandb_entity.description: W&B team name (not organization). Uses default team if omitted.

wandb_run_name.title: Wandb Run Name
wandb_run_name.description: W&B run name. Auto-generated if omitted.

max_validation_rows.title: Max Validation Rows
max_validation_rows.description: Max validation samples for evaluation during training (baseline, periodic, final)

language.title: Language
language.description: Full language name (e.g., 'english', 'greek'). Set to 'multilingual' to read per-sample language from the dataset's 'language' column (ISO 639-1 codes like 'en', 'el'). When 'multilingual' is set, samples without a language column are skipped. When set to a specific language (default), the dataset's language column is ignored. 'auto' is not supported for training.

normalizer.title: Normalizer
normalizer.description: Text normalizer for WER/CER computation during training evaluation. Options: 'auto' (select based on language — e.g., Greek normalizer for Greek), 'generic' (Unicode-aware: lowercase, strip punctuation, preserve all scripts), 'whisper-english' (aggressive English normalizer — numbers, contractions, fillers, British spelling), 'none' (no normalization — compare raw text), or a language name (e.g., 'greek').

max_train_samples.title: Max Train Samples
max_train_samples.description: Limit training to a random subset of N samples. Useful for quick experimentation.

max_grad_norm.title: Max Grad Norm
max_grad_norm.description: Gradient-clipping threshold. 0 = disabled, 1.0 = standard. Threaded through to Modal training scripts via Job.config.

TrainingRequest.title: TrainingRequest
TrainingRequest.description: Request to start a training job.

num_gpus.title: Num Gpus
num_gpus.description: GPU count. 1 = single-GPU (start_tts_training). >1 = DDP (start_tts_training_ddp; Orpheus only). Valid DDP values: 2, 4, 8.

use_unsloth.title: Use Unsloth
use_unsloth.description: DDP only (num_gpus > 1): use Unsloth for faster training (orpheus-ddp-unsloth). Ignored for single-GPU runs.

TrainingTTSV2Request.title: TrainingTTSV2Request
TrainingTTSV2Request.description:
v2 TTS training sub-model. Carries the single-GPU ``TTSTrainingRequest``
fields plus two DDP-specific knobs (``num_gpus``, ``use_unsloth``) that
previously required posting to the separate ``/api/v1/tts-training-ddp/jobs``
route (absorption decision A on #685). ``num_gpus > 1`` routes to
``start_tts_training_ddp`` instead of ``start_tts_training``.

TranscriptionRequest.title: TranscriptionRequest
TranscriptionRequest.description:
POST /api/v1/transcription request body (§4.6).

Required: ``model_id``, ``language``.
Exactly one input source: ``dataset_id``, ``parquet_urls``, or
``file_store_id``.

Project-scoped parameters — NEVER in the request body per §4.6:
``hf_token``, ``router_api_key``, ``s3_config``, ``output_target``.
Those arrive via the project's stored credentials + settings; a
request body that tries to override them is rejected by the
strict (``extra="forbid"``) config below.

TransferHfToS3Request.title: TransferHfToS3Request
TransferHfToS3Request.description: Import a HuggingFace repo (model or dataset) into a new S3 FileStore.

TransferS3ToHfRequest.title: TransferS3ToHfRequest
TransferS3ToHfRequest.description: Push an S3 FileStore to a HuggingFace repo.
